175		}

179		tagIndexWhitelist := opts.TagIndexWhitelist()

181			return nil, errors.New("only one of TagIndexBlacklist and TagIndexWhitelist can be specified")
182		}
183		if len(tagIndexBlacklist) > 0 {

185		} else if len(tagIndexWhitelist) > 0 {
186			tagFilters = append(tagFilters, dbmodel.NewWhitelistFilter(tagIndexWhitelist))
187		}

189		if len(tagFilters) == 0 {

191		} else if len(tagFilters) == 1 {
